implementation: A scoped research adapter constructs the existing full private executor first, then gives the unchanged selector a separate masked public planning view. Actual catalog, crew, tools, authorization and producers remain complete. The original PolicySession class is restored even on failure.
dependency_validation: Existing catalog validation derives the three capacity-vector component identities from f12/f13/f14, which this mask explicitly removes. A scoped validation-only copy reattaches these exact original public identity edges to validate catalog shape. It changes no reported/forecast/choice frame and no capacity arithmetic; the actual planner retains no such edges, no question bindings to them, and compute-only capacities. Other existing validation remains active and the original validator is restored on exit.
joint_choice_validation: The original constructor still validates the full actual intervention/catalog equality. The selector receives only remaining singleton candidates, restricted public binding/report support and UNMODELED questions with preserved bounds. Actual private execution bindings remain unchanged.
private_submission_binding: After an intention is recorded from the masked public frame, a private issue adapter supplies the unchanged full nominal registry to the real typed crew/intervention executors. Task, current time and evidence are identical; no additional record or truth is added. Public decisions remain masked. Native audit records both nominal hashes and the same evidence/time identity.
information_mask: Remove operator-report records and transitive copied descendants from the planner ledger only; retain registry and physical observations.
execution_identity: The outer exact phase lock includes every new adapter, preparation, capture and saved-audit script. Native runtime identity alone is not the full adapter identity; each native run also records the adapter SHA and both view identities.
engineering_witness: One new public non-held 3-second joint-choice interface witness, at most one physical call and three scheduled decisions; no scientific effect comparison or automatic retry.
